temp-mail: Use Refresh and read the status message. An expired inbox needs a new address; a blocked disposable domain needs an address accepted by the receiving service. Delivery depends on Guerrilla Mail and the sender. Do not include inbox credentials or private messages in a support report.
background-remover: Allow the model resources to finish loading and keep the tab open during processing. If the browser runs out of memory, retry with a smaller supported image and fewer open tabs. For missed hair, glass, or thin edges, improve the source photo or use an editor with manual selection.
pdf-merge: When a PDF cannot be merged

Check that every selected file is a readable, unencrypted PDF. Try each source in a PDF reader to identify a damaged file. If a large batch exhausts browser memory, use smaller batches and recheck page order. This tool has no password-unlocking control.
image-to-pdf: When an image cannot be converted

Open the source in an image viewer, then export a working copy as PNG or JPEG if the browser cannot decode its format. Retry with smaller images if memory is limited. Check the selected thumbnails before converting; this interface does not reorder or crop them.
qr-code-generator: When a QR code will not generate or scan

A capacity error needs a shorter message or URL. If the QR library did not load, reload with a working connection. For scanning failures, test the downloaded PNG, preserve its light border and square proportions, and check the final print size with a phone.
password-generator: Choose a whole-number length from 8 to 64 and at least one character group. Match the destination service's allowed symbols. If copying fails, select the displayed value manually and save it in your password manager; the tool does not keep a password history.
word-counter: When a count differs from another app

Compare the exact final text, including whitespace and line breaks. This counter uses whitespace for word boundaries and JavaScript string length for characters, so emoji and some languages can differ from another editor. The receiving form's counting rule determines its submission limit.
json-formatter: Inspect the reported error and the surrounding syntax. Replace single-quoted keys, remove trailing commas, and use lowercase true, false, and null. Comments require a different format such as JSONC; this formatter accepts standard JSON. Keep the original for duplicate keys and large-number checks.
base64-tool: Check that the input is complete standard Base64 rather than a Base64url token segment or a copied filename. Arbitrary binary bytes may not decode as UTF-8 text. Use the JWT Decoder for token inspection and a file-capable decoder for binary documents.
user-agent-generator: When a sample does not match your test

Select the intended browser or crawler sample, then check the receiving application's parser with that string. Samples do not update the browser's real identity or reproduce device capabilities. Use a real browser test when rendering behavior matters.
color-palette-generator: When palette or contrast results look wrong

Check which swatches are locked before generating another palette. Evaluate the exact foreground and background pair used in the design, including text size and hover states. A contrast preview for one pair does not validate every combination in the palette.
unit-converter: When a conversion has the wrong scale

Enter a finite numeric value and confirm both units and the measurement category. Zero is valid; a blank input is not. Temperature conversion includes an offset, unlike a simple length ratio. Check precision and rounding against the intended use.
url-encoder-decoder: When URL decoding reports an error

Check for an incomplete percent sequence or invalid encoded UTF-8. Choose component mode for one query value and URI mode for a complete URL. Avoid encoding an already encoded value again, and check how the receiving application treats plus signs.
jwt-decoder: When a token cannot be inspected

Remove a copied Bearer prefix and check that the sample has the expected dot-separated structure. Encrypted tokens require a different workflow. Use a harmless development token for support; successful decoding still does not verify the signature or grant access.
unix-timestamp-converter: When a timestamp shows an unexpected date

Confirm whether the source uses seconds or milliseconds and whether you are reading UTC or local output. The device timezone affects local values. Out-of-range numbers and invalid calendar input need correction before conversion.
hash-generator: When two digests do not match

Use the same algorithm and compare the exact UTF-8 text, including capitalization, trailing spaces, and line endings. Compare the same output representation. This text tool does not hash uploaded file bytes; use a file-checksum workflow for archives or downloads.
csv-to-json: Check the selected separator, quoted fields, header uniqueness, and column count in each row. Start with the header and one failing row to isolate the issue. Converted values remain strings, so check numeric or boolean requirements in the receiving application.
text-case-converter: Choose the intended transformation and review names, acronyms, and language-specific capitalization. Keep the original text for comparison. Copy failures can be handled by selecting the displayed output manually; capitalization rules do not replace editorial review.
text-diff-checker: When a comparison is too large or unexpected

Compare a smaller section if the workload limit is reached. Check blank lines and whitespace in both sources. This tool compares text lines, so moved lines can appear as removals and additions; it does not inspect rich-document formatting.
uuid-generator: Use a supported browser with cryptographic randomness and enter a count within the displayed range. Do not substitute a predictable counter when a random UUID is required. Save the generated list using Copy or Download; identifiers still need application access controls.
